page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is configured with 1 shared vCPU mapped to an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture.

The hardware profile includes 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage, nor does it feature dedicated GPU hardware. The baseline network bandwidth is specified at 0 Gbps, and there are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the server.

Given the shared CPU allocation and modest resource footprint, this server is positioned for low-intensity workloads. The qualitative cost profile is aligned with budget-conscious, utility-scale deployments where dedicated CPU execution time is not required. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, development environments, basic microservices, and low-traffic utility tasks.
